Description & Possible Values: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each payment transaction (e.g., TXN-20260001).
Unique identifier representing the business or vendor receiving the payment (e.g., MER-4821).
Exact date and timestamp when the transaction was initiated (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).
Monetary value of the transaction in Algerian Dinars (DZD / DA), ranging from small retail purchases (~500 DA) to larger orders (~600,000 DA).
Method or medium used to execute the payment: E-commerce (CIB / Edahabia), TPE / POS Terminal, Mobile App, Contactless / NFC, or Bank Transfer / Virement.
Final processing state of the payment: Accepted (approved & settled), Declined (rejected by bank/gateway), Refunded (reversed back to customer), or Cancelled (voided prior to settlement).
Industry sector of the merchant (e.g., Retail & Apparel, Food & Dining, Electronics & Tech, Travel & Hospitality).
